verdict.rationale: The pack documents no event-triggered rules or hooks. Recurring prompts [docs-30] run on a time schedule, not on events. Goals [docs-28] and message queuing [docs-29] are in-session continuation features. Headless mode embedded in CI scripts [docs-3] is a developer building block, where the host pipeline supplies the triggering, not a rule engine in the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
